note: Kiwibank, which has provided transactional banking to Niue's residents through a local agency since 2013 and serves almost the whole island: its personal banking fees (effective 14 May 2026, in New Zealand dollars) charge no account management fee on an everyday account; its 3 dollars a branch deposit or withdrawal isn't counted.

sources.title: Kiwibank, Niue renews banking services relationship with Kiwibank
sources.said: Kiwibank first started providing designated transactional banking services to all residents of Niue in 2013. ... Kiwibank currently serves over 1,400 Niueans on the island, which is almost the entire population of Niue.

sources.title: Kiwibank, Personal Banking Fees and Limits (effective 14 May 2026)
sources.said: Effective 14 May 2026 ... Everyday accounts ... Account management fee No fee.
